_comment: Fixed in-person checklists. Never AI-generated. Shown after every deal check.

GPU: Physical check: screws not stripped, no rust, no burnt smell, PCB not bent, fan spins freely, ports intact.
GPU-Z: check name, shader count, memory size/type, BIOS IDs. These are spoofable, treat as weak evidence only.
FurMark ~15 minutes: watch for artifacts, crashes, or thermal throttling (heat test only, not proof of health).
Run a real game you know and watch VRAM usage.
Pay only after testing. Get a written return policy. Never pay advance.
CPU: Check pins (socket side) for bends or damage.
Confirm it POSTs in a known-good board.
RAM: Run MemTest86 for each stick individually.
Confirm the rated speed is actually achieved, not just installed.
Test each stick solo to isolate faults.
MOTHERBOARD: Inspect for bent pins and bulging or leaking capacitors.
Confirm it POSTs with a known-good CPU and RAM.
Check all ports function (USB, SATA, display).
Confirm the BIOS version supports your CPU before buying.
PSU: Never trust the sticker wattage alone.
Use a PSU tester at minimum, ideally a real load test.
Prefer a known, branded PSU over no-name units.
SSD: Run CrystalDiskInfo (or similar) and check health and power-on hours.
Do a full write test across the real capacity (watch for fake capacity).
HDD: Run CrystalDiskInfo and check reallocated sectors and health.
Do a full write test across the real capacity (watch for fake capacity).
CASE: Physical check: fit, fan mounts, front I/O working.
Get a receipt and confirm return terms before paying.
COOLER: Physical check: fits your socket, fan spins freely, no cracked heatpipes.
Get a receipt and confirm return terms before paying.
OTHER: Physically inspect the item before paying.
Get a receipt and confirm return or test terms before paying.

caution_text: Price says little about quality or variant. Treat with caution.
test_before_pay: Always: test before paying, get a written return policy, and never send an advance.
disclaimer: These checks help but do not prove a part is genuine or healthy. Test in person before paying.
compat_user_checklist: PSU wattage and connectors are sufficient.
BIOS/chipset supports the CPU (check before buying a used board plus a new CPU).
compat_header: This tool does not verify compatibility. Tick what you checked yourself.
